headline: A DisplayPad that stops showing pictures is reset by itself, and the dial stays on the mode you chose.

items.title: DisplayPad brought back on its own
items.detail: After a Mac restart, the DisplayPad could keep answering its keys while showing nothing until it was unplugged. Everest now resets its USB connection, as a replug would, and redraws the keys. If that is not enough, the app says so and the keys keep working.

items.title: Dial mode
items.detail: The Displays page now shows the mode Everest applies, and the sidebar what the dial actually shows. After a restart, the app could show Volume selected while the dial was on the clock.

items.title: Quieter log
items.detail: The listener's log no longer fills up with live DisplayPad keys, and the previous log is kept as daemon.log.1.
